content.short: An all-in-one DeFi hub on Sui providing a CEX-like experience with smart order routing and multi-asset AMMs.
content.description:
Aftermath Finance is an all-in-one DeFi hub on the Sui blockchain, offering a centralized exchange (CEX) user experience with the transparency of on-chain finance. It features a DEX aggregator with smart order routing that finds the best prices across the ecosystem with zero platform fees. Its multi-asset AMM supports liquidity pools with up to 12 assets, allowing for diverse portfolio management.

The platform also provides liquid staking through afSUI, enabling users to maintain liquidity while earning staking rewards. With additional features like perpetuals and isolated lending, Aftermath Finance serves as a comprehensive gateway to the Sui DeFi landscape.
